mainEntity.name: How much does an outdoor kitchen typically cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an outdoor kitchen in Los Angeles varies widely based on size, materials, and features. A basic setup with a grill and counter might start around $10,000 to $20,000. More elaborate designs incorporating high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, extensive counter space, and specialized features like a pizza oven or bar can range from $30,000 to over $100,000. Factors like plumbing, electrical work, and permits also influence the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Outdoor kitchen costs in Los Angeles range from $10,000 for basic setups to over $100,000 for elaborate designs, depending on features, materials, and necessary utility work.
